name: Dynamax Clash Deck Building Gift Box

releases.name: Dynamax Clash Deck Building Gift Box

description.text: The Dynamax Clash Deck Building Gift Box (极巨争锋 卡组构筑礼盒) came out on 19 May 2023 for players who wanted to build their own Sword & Shield deck. It held one random Pokémon V holo, one of nine made in equal numbers: Rillaboom V, Centiskorch V, Lapras V, Toxtricity V, Wobbuffet V, Stonjourner V, Grimmsnarl V, Copperajah V and Snorlax V. With it came 19 Trainer cards picked from Dynamax Clash, a Special Energy, 48 basic Energy (six of each of eight types), a random 25-card Dynamax Clash booster pack, a player's guide and a deck box. On Pokémon's Tmall store only members could buy it.
